_comment: Example input for scripts/build_schedule_page.py — a curated, approved schedule (not the raw recommend output). Built from the Ada Lovelace demo profile in profile-example.json, real events from the bundled dataset. Copy the shape, not the specifics. Only a first name goes on the page — no last name, company, title, or RSVP mechanics. Give each day a "date" (YYYY-MM-DD) so the week strip at the top can highlight and jump-link to it.
